**Combine Pool:** Create a collective pool $P = \bigcup_{i=1}^{k} R_i$ containing all representatives from all configurations.
**Pairwise Comparison:** Apply the Elo rating method to the pool $P$.
**Calculate Average Ranking:** For each configuration $h_i$, calculate the average ranking of its representatives $R_i$ in the pool $P$.
